title: Empty-support branch of the finite-coefficient support induction step
statement: The empty-support branch of the finite-coefficient support-induction conclusion in the parent node, with the additional hypothesis that the closed subscheme Y is empty.

proof.text: Choose the base finite coefficient field and the zero module. A rank-zero finite presentation on the trivial stratification proves constructibility. On an empty scheme every pro-etale object has an empty covering, so the target pullback module is zero; scalar extension preserves the zero object, and the unique isomorphism between zero objects gives the required comparison.
